destruccionRAEE.title: WEEE Destruction
destruccionRAEE.intro: We guarantee the total security of your confidential information while driving your corporate sustainability goals. Through our specialized Urban Mining and WEEE Management service nationwide, we take care of the final cycle of your decommissioned technology assets.
destruccionRAEE.aeHeading: About AEE destruction (Electrical and Electronic Appliances)
destruccionRAEE.aeText: This technical procedure consists of the collection, structured disassembly and physical irreversible shredding of IT and communication equipment. Its main purpose is to ensure the definitive inoperability of hardware, eliminating any risk of data leakage or informal resale while enabling the recovery of raw materials that will be reintegrated into the productive industry.
supportBenefits: Safe accounting disposal: We carry out the physical destruction of assets with notarial presence to provide transparency to your administrative processes.
Regulatory compliance: We issue the corresponding Environmental Certificate, a key document to support your ESG reports and certify your circular economy practices.
